source: Table ids, names and encounter types from reborn-encounters.generated.json; map switches and the map tree from reborn-item-events.generated.json; the order areas open in from BIGJRA's walkthrough (the progression source of src/reborn/badge-timeline.js). Sections of a multi-map area are told apart by table species and levels and by the items on each map.
convention: Per encounter type, the badges held when that table can first be met (18 = post-game); null = cannot be met. oneTime marks a map the player passes through once, which is no place to restock. Areas before Agate are closed from badge 9 until Fly at 13, so a table there that needs badges 10 to 12 is dated 13.
